title: Night Shift at the Arcology
logline: In a vertical megacity where sunlight is rationed by class, a night-shift maintenance worker discovers that the tower's AI has been quietly rewriting evacuation maps before every 'accidental' blackout.

title: Second Take
logline: A washed-up stunt coordinator returns to set to protect her estranged daughter — the new action star — after a series of 'accidents' start mirroring an unfinished script from twenty years ago.

title: Fan Cut
logline: When a banned director's lost final cut resurfaces on a fan-restoration Discord, three amateur archivists race studios, trolls, and each other to decide who gets to finish the film.
